title: Await cancellation cleanup without an invented two-second deadline
purpose: The two commit-cancellation fixtures wrap their existing cleanup Notify in an unrelated two-second timeout, although no product two-second cleanup SLA is declared. Keep the cleanup behavior contract and remove that fixture-only deadline.
task: Modify only R1 after this brief is recorded. The coordinator owns tests, candidate commit, exact venue battery and installation. Documentation-only bookkeeping is limited to documentation_wall; no product Rust outside R1.

requirements.title: Await both existing cleanup notifications directly
requirements.spec: WHEN the default or named commit-cancellation fixture drops its pending completion and releases the held credential transaction, THE TEST SHALL await cleanup_observed.notified() directly. It SHALL remove only the two tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(2), cleanup_observed.notified()).await? wrappers. It SHALL retain ObservedDrop notification ownership, the two pending-state polls, cancellation/drop order, no-credential-write assertion, retired named slot assertion, fresh replacement identity assertion and replacement abort. It SHALL NOT add sleeps, polling, retries, a replacement timeout or an ignored/relaxed assertion. Production credential-lock/device-login timing is unchanged. The venue workflow test activity retains its existing four-hour bound for a stuck test process.
acceptance: Both cancelling_default_commit_while_lock_waits_never_writes and cancelling_named_commit_while_lock_waits_retires_slot reach their unchanged behavior assertions after cleanup notification.

Acceptance grep: cleanup_observed.notified().await; appears exactly twice; no timeout call wraps cleanup_observed.notified(). The unrelated device-poll notification timeout and existing OAuth options remain unchanged.
The exact diff changes only the two cleanup timeout statements; no production source, duration values, assertions, polling logic, sleeps, retries or suppressions are added or changed.
